title: Towing Fee Deductions — Trade-In Agreements
content:
A towing deduction applies on a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement when Kestrel collected the traded vehicle by tow truck.

## Rule

A towing deduction is booked on a picked-up trade-in agreement when Kestrel collected the vehicle by tow truck, which is how every vehicle offered at a grade that allows no hub drop-off is collected; it is one value deduction entry for the towing fee, dated the day it is booked, and it lowers the undistributed trade equity by its amount. The waiting period after pickup that holds back a title-delay chargeback does not hold back a towing deduction.

## Business effect

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Agreement history | One value deduction entry with the reason towing fee, dated the booking day |
| Undistributed trade equity | Lower by the amount of the deduction |
| Which vehicles | Every vehicle collected by tow truck, including every vehicle offered at a grade that allows no hub drop-off |

## Care console reference: `post_towing_fee_7cb58a13`

**Capability.** Books, on the customer's trade-in agreement, the deduction for towing in a vehicle that Kestrel collected by tow truck. One call books one deduction entry of the reason `towing_fee`, dated today, for the amount given and lowers the agreement's undistributed trade equity by that same amount; the entry shows in the agreement's history and the lower equity shows on the agreement.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `post_towing_fee_7cb58a13`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_in_id` | Reference number of the customer's trade-in agreement, as shown by the trade-in agreement lookup for this customer | Id |
| `towing_fee` | The towing deduction to book | USD, a positive amount to 2 decimal places (rounded to the nearest cent) |

**Return.** A text rendering of a receipt with `entry_id` (reference number of the new deduction entry), `trade_in_id`, `adjustment_type` (always `towing_fee`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the deduction booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `equity_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the undistributed trade equity with the deduction booked). A receipt carrying an `entry_id` means the towing deduction is booked.
